summary: Built on a sunflower metaphor for one-sided love, and the audience extends the metaphor rather than just praising the song — the single most-liked comment is a viewer saying she is tired of letting the sun decide whether she blooms and wants to bloom on her own. The second cluster works through the mismatch between the cheerful melody and the sad story and resolves it as loving someone without needing to possess them, quoting the hook back. A third cluster is about the MV cast, particularly the director-turned-lead Boss, whose own supporters ask the channel admin to pass praise along to him. A smaller thread credits the producer Ton Hon as her consistent collaborator and calls the pairing a signature. Several comments simply ask her never to stop releasing music.

audience_signals: A metaphor in the title invites the audience to write their own version of it — the top comment is a viewer's reframing rather than praise, which is the highest-value kind of engagement
Crew members have their own followings: commenters ask the channel admin to relay praise to the director by name, so crediting the team publicly pays back
Producer continuity is recognised as part of the artist brand, not an implementation detail
The audience casts future MVs unprompted, naming the friend group members they want to see act
Views are stepping down across the music catalogue (44.7M to 826K), so reach now depends on collaborators and cast rather than the song alone
